includes: Our commitment to small groups ensures an intimate and personalized experience, with ample in-water snorkel time and individual attention provided.
All snorkeling gear is provided, as well as tropical juice, water, and light snacks.
We provide wetsuits, snorkel gear, water, and juice for your convenience.
Private Custom Island Tour: up to 8 guests per booking.
Guides who provide knowledge and personal attention
blurb: Liquid Hawai‘i Charters offers small group guided snorkel trips, night snorkeling with manta rays, and seasonal whale watching tours. They operate from Kawaihae on the Big Island, providing a local and intimate ocean experience. Private charters are also available for customized adventures.
